# Unit 2 consolidation — Week 15

Lesson 1: closed-book diagnosis. Explain a key/reference, 2NF versus 3NF, inner join, CIA/AAA, factors, cipher and privacy/testing boundary. Mark using the linked chapter answers; record evidence of the gap.
Lesson 2: stations. A: fresh four-table normalisation from the review's club case. B: SQL active/category report, row-count/sum trap and controlled change with rollback. C: CIA/AAA scenario with control/limit. D: cipher mapping and data-quality/privacy decision. Choose two stations that address areas you need to practise; use the earlier downloads.
Lesson 3: unfamiliar transfer. A returned loan looks overdue; two cameras share a description; a borrower with no loans is omitted from an inner-join loan report; a valid-looking date is wrong; a suspicious message has not been clicked. Explain each without relying on labels alone.
Lesson 4: correction/revision plan. Write what went wrong, the rule, a corrected solution and a fresh retest. Evidence must include why the answer works. No new project or extra exam-week deadline.

Revision log: topic / diagnostic evidence / priority / practice action / corrected explanation / retest result. Consult unit2-coverage-audit.md; a topic marked mapped is not automatically mastered.
